optional For Serving: Chopped Fresh Cilantro, Cucumbers, And Bread/rolls/rice/noodles
Short background story: I Was craving cold noodles one hot, balmy day in July. I yelped up A place in Chinatown that served cold hand pulled noodles and famous lamb burgers (shown on Anthony Bourdains food Show once). Both turned out to be amazing and the Place quickly became a favorite for me and my boyfriend. My boyfriend, not living in New York at the time, wanted to produce the lamb burgers at home, but couldnt use Meat as he would be making them for him and his father, a vegan. His attempt turned out rather bland, so I thought Id Bring the vegan party up Here and Try to make them myself. My attempt, As follows, turned out rather well, if you ask me. 1. Chop up the seitan so that its pretty small and then mix with all of the remaining ingredients except for the butter and the serving options. Let the mixture marinate for 30 minutes to an hour. 2. Melt the butter in a skillet at medium heat (I realize that Butter is not vegan, but I thought the mixture needed a little fat and, well, Im not vegan, so why not?). 3. Pour the marinating Mixture into the skillet And cook until the seitan is slightly brown dont over cook! 4. Take out of skillet, top with cilantro, cucumber, and put on top of bread/rolls/rice/noodles. Aside: The real Xian lamb burgers are served on a roll similar to an arepa, which I lack the cooking skills to try to reproduce on my own. I mixed my seitan mixture in with some Rice noodles.

For the apricot jam sauce: Pour into a bowl the apricot jam, crushed pineapple, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes. For the slaw: In a food processor, add water, oil, onion, garlic, salt, and lime juice. Pulse until the ingredients are mixed. Add the sour cream and pulse again. In a bowl, add the shredded red and green cabbage. Pour the oil mixture and toss. For the coconut shrimp: In a bowl, mix the beer, milk, egg, flour, baking powder, and salt. Dip the peeled, headless shrimp in the batter. Coat with coconut flakes. Then fry in hot oil until the coconut is golden. Place the shrimp on a wire rack placed over a plate so the excess oil can drip off. Let cool. Moisten a rice paper sheet and place the slaw in the middle of the edge (about 1/3 of the way from the edge). Roll until the top of the slaw is covered with the rice paper. After the shrimp have cooled, take two shrimp from the wire rack and put them on top of the slaw. Then continue to wrap, and the shrimp will be tightly rolled up in the paper. Slice the spring rolls in half and serve with the apricot jam sauce.

1 cup red kidney beans (either the small or the larger, more elongated variety), soaked for 4 hours or longer in 1 quart water
1 bay leaf
2 large onions, 1 cut in half, the other thinly sliced
Salt to taste
3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil or grapeseed oil, plus additional olive oil for drizzling
4 garlic cloves, minced
1 generous bunch spinach (about 3/4 pound), stemmed, washed thoroughly and coarsely chopped, or 2 6-ounce bags baby spinach
1 cup tightly packed, coarsely chopped flat-leaf parsley
1 cup tightly packed, coarsely chopped cilantro
1 cup thinly sliced scallions (2 bunches)
2 dried limes (available in Persian markets), soaked in hot water to cover for 15 minutes (optional) (place a small plate over the limes to keep them submerged)
Freshly ground pepper
Fresh lemon juice for serving
1. Drain the kidney beans and rinse. 

Place in a large saucepan and add 1 quart fresh water. 

Bring to a boil over medium-high heat and skim off any foam. 

Add the bay leaf, halved onion, 1 of the garlic cloves, and salt to taste. Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer 1 hour. 

Remove the bay leaf and halved onion and discard. 

2. 

Meanwhile, heat 3 tablespoons oil over medium heat in a heavy soup pot or Dutch oven and add the sliced onion. Cook, stirring often, until it begins to color. Turn the heat to low, add a generous pinch of salt and continue to cook, stirring often, until the onion is dark brown and has melted down to about half its original volume, about 20 minutes. Stir in the remaining garlic and cook, stirring, until it is fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the beans with their broth and bring to a simmer. 

Simmer, partly covered, for 30 to 60 minutes, until the beans are tender. 

Taste and adjust salt. 3. Add the spinach by the handful, stirring until wilted before adding the next handful, until all of the spinach has been added. Stir in the herbs and scallions. 

Using a needle, pierce the limes in a few places and add them along with 1/2 cup of their soaking water (if you aren't using the limes, just add an additional 1/2 cup water). Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes, until the greens and herbs are tender but still bright. 

Taste and adjust salt. 

Add pepper. 

Remove the dried limes before serving. 4. Serve with lemon wedges and squeeze fresh lemon juice into each bowl. 

Note: You can also add lemon juice directly to the stew, but the acid will dull the color of the greens in a short time. Number of Servings: 6  This dish comes  from  the Piedmont region where fine wine and beef are produced. Rub garlic  into meat. Season with  salt and pepper. Place meat  in  a large bowl. Add  in bay leaves, thyme and sufficient wine to cover meat. Cover and chill  overnight. Drain meat, reserving marinade. Dry meat with paper  towels.   Heat 2 Tbsp. butter with  oil in a large heavy casserole. When butter foams, add in meat. brown  meat on  all sides over medium heat. Remove meat  from casserole.  Add in onion, carrot and celery to casserole. Saute/fry till lightly browned. Return meat to   casserole. Pour reserved marinade through a strainer over meat. Cover casserole and reduce heat. 2 lаrgе асоrn squаsh
1/2 оnіоn
4 оunсеs mushrооms
3/4 сuр rісоttа сhееsе (sее Сооkіng 101, bеlоw)
3/4 сuр grаtеd Swіss сhееsе
1 еgg
1/2 tеаsрооn grоund nutmеg
Sаlt аnd рерреr
1/4 сuр brеаdсrumbs
Uр tо 4 hоurs bеfоrе mеаltіmе, сut а smаll slісе оff оnе sіdе оf еасh squаsh sо thеуll sіt flаt. Сut оff аbоut оnе-fоurth оf thе орроsіtе sіdе оf thе squаsh (tо gіvе уоu ассеss tо thе hоllоw іn thе mіddlе) аnd dіsсаrd. Sсrаре оut thе sееds аnd strіngs wіth а sрооn. Ρееl thе оnіоn аnd сut іntо 1/8- tо 1/4-іnсh ріесеs. Сut thе еnds оff thе mushrооm stеms, dіsсаrd, аnd сut thе mushrооms іntо 1/4- tо 3/8-іnсh ріесеs. Соmbіnе thе оnіоn, mushrооms, rісоttа сhееsе, Swіss сhееsе, еgg, аnd nutmеg, аnd stіr wеll. Sеаsоn wіth sаlt аnd рерреr. Рlасе thе squаsh іn а bаkіng dіsh, sрооn hаlf оf thе сhееsе mіхturе іntо еасh squаsh, thеn sрrіnklе thе brеаdсrumbs оvеr thе сhееsе. Соvеr wіth рlаstіс wrар аnd rеfrіgеrаtе untіl rеаdу tо bаkе. Αbоut 1 1/2 hоurs bеfоrе mеаltіmе, рrеhеаt thе оvеn tо 375F. Rеmоvе thе рlаstіс wrар аnd bаkе thе squаsh fоr 1 hоur, оr untіl а fоrk slіdеs еаsіlу іntо thе squаsh. Ρlасе еасh squаsh іn а shаllоw bоwl аnd sеrvе іmmеdіаtеlу. Yоu hаvе tо dо thіs аt lеаst оnсе, sо уоu саn nоnсhаlаntlу sау, І lіkе tо mаkе mу оwn rісоttа. Неаt 1/2 gаllоn оf whоlе mіlk tо 200F, stіrrіng frеquеntlу tо kеер іt frоm sсоrсhіng. Whеn іt rеасhеs 200F, stіr іn 2 tаblеsрооns оf frеsh lеmоn juісе. Ιt wіll іnstаntlу сurdlе (іf іt dоеsnt, kеер hеаtіng). Rеmоvе frоm thе hеаt аnd lеt stаnd fоr 5 mіnutеs. Lіnе а соlаndеr wіth а соuрlе lауеrs оf сhееsесlоth аnd slоwlу роur іn thе mіlk mіхturе. Αllоw іt tо drаіn untіl thе сhееsесlоth іs сооl еnоugh tо hаndlе. Gаthеr thе еnds оf thе сhееsесlоth tоgеthеr аnd tіе іntо а bаg. Susреnd thе bаg оvеr thе sіnk аnd аllоw tо drаіn fоr 1 hоur, thеn usе оr rеfrіgеrаtе.

The ingredients are: 1 can clams (canned) 1 big onion 2 potatoes 3 carrots 3 celery sticks 50 g or 100 g ham or bacon 3 tbsp. Butter 100 ml white wine 1 tsp salt 2 tbsp. flour 800 ml milk 1 tbsp. Parmesan cheese 2 tbsp. heavy cream This is the can of clams I used: there is a liquid in it. Separate the clams and the juice. Cut up all the ingredients. Cut the carrots into smaller pieces than the potatoes and if you cut the celery even smaller it will be even better when it's cooked. Soften the onion in 3 tablespoons of butter. I used ham, but if you use bacon, fry it until it's fried, then use the grease to soften the onion. If there's not enough grease, add butter. After the onions are soft, add the celery, carrots, garlic and cook it all together. Add the white wine and keep it on the stove on a high heat. Then add the potatoes and the ham and cook it for a while. Add the flour to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly so that it doesn't stick. Add milk, clam juice and broth and stir it up. When you see that it starts to boil, turn the heat down. I used this chicken broth. It's a granule. When the vegetables are cooked about 80%, add the clams. Then the soup is at its thickest, and add Parmesan cheese powder. Also add cream. Season with herbs. Served with crackers or delicious bread.

1 23 cups bittersweet chocolate chips, divided
2 14 cups all-purpose flour

12 teaspoon salt
34 cup light brown sugar

2 large eggs
1 12 teaspoons almond extract
1 cup slivered almonds, toasted
PREHEAT oven to 325 degrees F & grease your baking sheet. MICROWAVE 2/3 cup morsels in uncovered, microwave-safe bowl on HIGH (100%) power for 10 to 15 seconds; STIR. The morsels may retain some of their orignal shape; if neccessary, microwave at additional 10- to 15-second intervals, stirring just untill morsels are melted. COMBINE flour, baking powder and salt in small bowl. Beat sugar and butter in large bowl untill light and fluffy; add eggs and almond extract; beat untill combined. Stir in melted chocolate; gradually stir in flour mixture then stir in slivered almonds and 1/2 cup morsels. SHAPE dough with floured hands on prepared baking sheet into 12 x 3-inch log; round top. BAKE for 40 minutes or untill slightly firm to the touch and cracked on top; cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes. Slide log onto cutting board and cut into 18 even slices then return to baking sheet cut side down. Bake for additional 10 to 15 minutes or untill firm. then remove to wire rack to cool completely. Place remaining chocolate morsels in small, heavy-duty plastic bag and microwave on HIGH (100%) power for 30 to 45 seconds; knead. Cut a tiny corner from bag and drizzle over cooled biscotti. Let stand untill drizzle is set and store in airtight container at room temperature.

1-1/2 cups graham crumbs
1/3 cup butter, melted
4 pkg. (250 g each) Philadelphia Brick Cream Cheese, softened
1 cup sugar
2 Tbsp. flour
2 tsp. vanilla
1 cup sour cream
4 eggs
red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple gel food colourings
Heat oven to 325F. Combine graham crumbs and butter; press onto bottom of parchment-lined 9-inch springform pan. Bake 10 min. Meanwhile, beat next 4 ingredients in large bowl with mixer untill blended. Add sour cream; mix well. Add eggs, 1 at a time, mixing on low speed after each just untill blended. Measure about 1-3/4 cups batter into seperate bowl; tint with red food colouring. Measure 1-1/2 cups of the remaining batter into seperate bowl; tint with orange food colouring. Continue to divide remaining batter into 4 additional bowls, decreasing measure of batter in each bowl by additional 1/4 cup as you work your way down to the last bowl which should have only about 1/2 cup batter. Tint each of the remaining plain batters with a different colour food colouring, adding in order listed in ingredient list. Pour red batter over centre of crust. Repeat with remaining batters, one colour at a time, starting with the batter with the most volume and working your way down to the batter with the least volume, and always pouring batters over batter in centre of pan. Bake 1 hour to 1 hour 5 min. or untill centre is allmost set. Turn off oven. Open oven door slightly. Let cheesecake stand in oven 1 hour. Run knife around rim of pan to loosen cake; cool completely before removing rim. Refrigerate 4 hours.

Preheat oven to 325°F. In a bowl, whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, grated zest, grated juice from 1 lemon (preferably Meyer), ground cloves, and salt. Whisk in yogurt and cranberries. At the bottom of a large roasting pan, set 8 ramekins, each about 8 ounces, and pour about 12 cup of the yogurt mixture into each. Add enough boiling water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake about 12 minutes, until the custards are set but still slightly soft in the center. Let cool on a rack at room temperature. Meanwhile, in a saucepan, cook the cranberries, sugar, and lemon juice, stirring constantly, over high heat, stirring constantly, until just tender, about 2 minutes. Pour into a bowl and let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes. Drain and reserve the syrup. Toss the apple and fennel with the olive oil and a pinch of salt. Spoon the cranberries and apple salad over the custards and serve.

- 1 1/2 cups water

Directions

2. 

Dust a work surface or counter generously with flour. Gently scrape the dough out of the bowl, and place on a floured surface. Sprinkle the top of the dough with a little more flour, and fold it over on itself once or twice. 

Cover loosely with plastic wrap and allow the dough to rest for about 15 minutes. 3. Using just enough flour to keep dough from sticking to work surface or to your fingers, gently and quickly shape the dough into a ball. Place a tea towel or cotton dish towel on your work surface and generously dust it with wheat bran, cornmeal, or flour. Set the dough seam-side down on the towel and dust with more wheat bran, cornmeal, or flour. 

Cover with another towel and allow to rest for about 2 hours, or until dough has doubled in size. 

4. 

About a half-hour before dough is ready, preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Place a 6- to 8-quart heavy covered pot (cast iron, enamel, Pyrex or ceramic) in the oven as it heats. When dough is ready, carefully remove the pot from the oven. Slide your hand under the towel and turn the dough over into the pot, seam-side up. 

Shake the pan once or twice if dough is unevenly distributed; it will straighten out as it bakes. Cover with the lid and bake 30 minutes, then remove the lid and bake another 15 to 30 minutes, until loaf is beautifully browned. 

Cool on a rack.

Chicken Toulouse Roulade 

Ingredients
4 slices bacon, diced
1/2 cup diced onion
1/2 cup diced green bell pepper
1/2 cup diced red bell pepper
1/2 cup chopped mushrooms
1/2 cup chopped celery
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp olive oil
2 1/2 cups diced chicken thigh meat
1/2 cup dry white wine
1/2 cup chicken stock
1/2 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp flour
1/2 tsp dried thyme
1/2 tsp dried marjoram

Instructions
1. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, fry the bacon until crisp. Remove the bacon with a slotted spoon, and drain all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the skillet.
2. Add the onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, mushrooms, and celery to the skillet. Stir in the garlic, salt, and black pepper. Cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Add the olive oil to the skillet, then stir in the chicken thigh meat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
4. Pour the wine into the skillet, and stir in the chicken stock, heavy cream, butter, flour, dried thyme, and dried marjoram. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Simmer for 10 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
5. Remove the skillet from the heat, and stir in the crisp bacon. Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
6. To prepare the roulade, lay a sheet of plastic wrap on a work surface. Lay one sheet of phyllo dough on the plastic wrap, and brush it with melted butter. Cover with another sheet of phyllo dough, and brush with more melted butter. Continue layering the phyllo dough and brushing with melted butter until you have used 10 sheets of phyllo dough.
7. Spoon the chicken mixture along one long edge of the phyllo dough, and shape it into a compact log. Roll the log in the phyllo dough, and transfer it to a baking sheet.
8. Brush the top of the roulade with melted butter, and bake in a preheated 350-degree F (175-degree C) oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy.

Ingredients:

For the Egg Rolls:

- 1 lb of shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 2 cups of shredded cabbage
- 1 cup of shredded carrots
- 2 green onions, finely chopped
- 2 cloves of garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon of soy sauce
- 1 teaspoon of sesame oil
- 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper
- 12 egg roll wrappers
- 1 egg, beaten
- Vegetable oil for frying

For the Dipping Sauce:

- 1/2 cup of sweet chili sauce
- 1 tablespoon of soy sauce
- 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar
- 1/2 teaspoon of sesame oil

Instructions:

1. In a large pan, heat a tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add the shrimp and cook until they turn pink. Remove the shrimp from the pan and chop them into small pieces.

2. In the same pan, add the cabbage, carrots, green onions, and garlic. Cook for about 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

3. Add the chopped shrimp back into the pan. Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper. Cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let the mixture cool.

4. Lay an egg roll wrapper on a clean surface. Place about 2 tablespoons of the shrimp mixture on the lower third of the wrapper. Fold the bottom corner over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll tightly. Seal the edge with the beaten egg. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.

5. Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large pot to 350°F (175°C). Fry the egg rolls in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

6. To make the dipping sauce, combine the sweet chili sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a small bowl. Stir until well mixed.

7. Serve the Shrimpylicious Egg Rolls hot with the dipping sauce. Enjoy!

Note: Be careful not to overfill the egg roll wrappers, as this can cause them to burst during frying. Also, make sure to seal the edges well to prevent the filling from leaking out.

1 tsp sugar

1/4 tsp sesame oil

1/4 tsp ground ginger

3 oz bamboo shoots, sliced
3 oz water chestnuts, sliced
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice wine (or dry sherry)
1 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp sugar
1/4 tsp sesame oil

Instructions:

1. Drain tofu and wrap in a kitchen towel. Set aside for 10 minutes.
2. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine 1 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp rice wine, 1 tsp cornstarch, 1 tsp sugar, 1/4 tsp white pepper, 1/4 tsp sesame oil, and 1/4 tsp Chinese five-spice powder.

Toasted-Almond Panna Cotta with Maple Roasted Pears Recipe

Ingredients for Panna Cotta:

- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 2 tbsp powdered gelatin
- 1/4 cup sliced almonds

Ingredients for Roasted Pears:

- 4 ripe pears, peeled and sliced
- 2 tbsp maple syrup
- 1 tbsp unsalted butter

Instructions:

1. In a saucepan, combine heavy cream, whole milk, and sugar. Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly until the sugar dissolves.

2. Remove the mixture from heat and add chopped almonds and gelatin. Stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved.

3. Pour the mixture into ramekins or mold, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until set.

4. For the roasted pears, preheat the oven to 375°F. Arrange sliced pears in a baking dish, drizzle with maple syrup, and dot with butter. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the pears are tender and caramelized.

5. To serve, run a knife around the edge of each ramekin to loosen the panna cotta, then invert onto a plate. Top with maple roasted pears and serve immediately.

Enjoy your delicious Toasted-Almond Panna Cotta with Maple Roasted Pears!

She uses sun-dried tomatoes (which I love) and walnuts to make her dressing, which has a nice balance and flavor. Use the recipe as a reference but add a few ingredients of your own choice or substitute the walnuts with almonds.

This dish is a beautiful contrast to the savory side dishes you add to salads throughout the week. Make it a side for a crowd and have leftovers for lunch for the week. To get this salad you will need one box of Sun-dried Tomato paste (6 oz). It's also wonderful to use the leftovers from other dishes on your plate; to get that taste of sun dried tomato I like to use canned chopped tomatoes or use 4-5 large tomatoes, chopped into a couple of pieces. And of course, that dressing, it's so rich and velvety."

Cowboy Quiche 2 Recipe:

Ingredients:
- 1 pre-made pie crust
- 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
- 1 small onion, diced
- 1 bell pepper, diced
- 1 cup cooked sausage, crumbled
- 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
- 4 large eggs
- 1 cup milk
- Salt and pepper, to taste

Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and place the pre-made pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish. Set aside.

2. In a skillet over medium heat, cook the bacon untill crispy. Remove the bacon from the skillet, crumble it, and set it aside. Reserve about 1 tablespoon of bacon grease in the skillet.

3. In the same skillet with the bacon grease, sauté the diced onion and bell pepper untill they become tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

4. In a medium-sized bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk untill well combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

5. Spread the crumbled sausage, cooked bacon, sautéed onion, and bell pepper evenly over the bottom of the prepared pie crust.

6. Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the meat and vegetable mixture.

7. Pour the egg and milk mixture over the cheese, ensuring that it covers all the ingredients.

8. Place the loaded quiche in the preheated oven and bake for 30-35 minutes, or untill the center is set and the top is golden brown.

9. Once cooked, remove the Cowboy Quiche from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing.

10. Serve the quiche warm as breakfast, brunch, or even a hearty dinner. It pairs well with a side salad for a complete meal.

Enjoy the savory and flavorful Cowboy Quiche 2!

Here is a recipe for caramel-marshmallow brownies:

Ingredients:

- 1 cup butter, melted
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 4 eggs
- 1 cup cocoa powder
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips
- 1 cup chopped pecans (optional)
- 1 jar (13 oz) caramel ice cream topping
- 3 cups mini marshmallows

Instructions:

1. 

Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). 

Line a 9x13-inch baking pan with aluminum foil, allowing the foil to overhang the edges of the pan. 

Spray the foil with nonstick cooking spray. 2. In a large bowl, combine the melted butter, sugar, eggs, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract. 

Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until well combined. 3. In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in the chocolate chips and pecans, if using. 

4. Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan and spread it into an even layer. 

5. 

Bake the brownies for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 

Allow the brownies to cool completely. 6. In a small saucepan, heat the caramel topping over low heat until it is pourable. 

Pour the caramel over the cooled brownies and spread it into an even layer. 7. 

Sprinkle the marshmallows over the caramel layer and use a spatula to gently press them into the caramel. 8. 

Place the brownies under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the marshmallows are golden brown. 

Watch carefully to avoid burning. 9. Allow the brownies to cool completely before cutting and serving. 

Enjoy!

Ingredients:

* 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
* 2 eggs
* 1/2 cup milk
* 1/2 cup grated cheese (such as cheddar or Swiss)
* 1/2 cup chopped broccoli florets
* 1/4 cup chopped Onion
* 1/4 cup chopped ham or bacon (optional)
* Salt and pepper to taste
* 2 tablespoons butter, melted
* 1/4 cup heavy cream (optional)

instructions:

2. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt to make the crepe batter.
3. Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt the pan To evenly coat the bottom.
4. cook the crepe for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is light brown. Loosen the edges with a spatula and flip the crepe Over. Cook for another minute, until The Other side is light brown as well.

6. In a separate bowl, whisk together the grated cheese, chopped broccoli, chopped onion, and chopped ham or bacon (if using).

8. Fold the edges of the crepes over the filling, making Sure to seal the edges well.

10. Bake the quiche cups for 20-25 minutes, or until the crepes are golden brown

Baked Endive with Ham Recipe:

ingredients:
- 1 head of endive
- 4 oz of diced meat
- 2 cups of milk
- 2 cups of breadcrumbs
- salt and pepper
- 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan cheese

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C).

2. Rinse the endive leaves and pat them dry with a paper cloth. Cut off the rough inner edges of the leaves and place them on a baking sheet filled with parchment paper.

3. In a large mixing spoon, add the breadcrumbs, sugar, and pepper.

4. Spread the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the cut side of each endive leaf.

5. Place a large piece of meat on top of each flower, pressing down slowly so that the breadcrumbs stick to the meat.

6. Dot the centers of each leaf with a large chunk of sugar.

7. Sprinkle the grated Parmesan butter over the bottom of each ham.

8. Bake in the pan for 15-20 days, or until the bread is golden brown and the breadcrumbs are crisp.

9. Remove from the pan and let it cool for a few seconds before serving. Enjoy!

London Broil Recipe:

Ingredients:
- 1 1/2 lbs of flank steak or sirloin
- 1/2 cup of olive oil
- 1/4 cup of red wine vinegar
- 2 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce
- 2 cloves of garlic, minced
- 1 teaspoon of dried thyme
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:

1. In medium-sized bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper until well combined.

2. Place the steak in a resealable plastic bag, and pour the marinade over it. Seal bag, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to allow the steak to marinate.

3. Preheat your grill to high heat.

4. Remove the steak from marinade, and pat it dry with paper towels.

5. Place the steak on the grill, and cook for about 5-6 minutes per side, or until internal temperature of steak reaches 145°F for medium-rare.

6. Remove steak from grill, and allow it to rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy!

Title: Drunken Chicken and Potatoes

Ingredients:
- 4 chicken thighs, Bone-in and skin-on
- 4 medium-sized Potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
- 1 onion, thinly sliced
- 4 cloves of garlic, minced
- 1 cup of white wine
- 1 cup Of chicken broth
- 2 tablespoons of olive oil
- 2 tablespoons of butter
- 1 tablespoon of fresh rosemary, chopped
- 1 tablespoon of fresh thyme, chopped
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:

1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).

2. Season the chicken thighs generously with salt and pepper on Both sides.

3. In a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven, Heat the olive oil and butter over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, skin-side down, and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Flip The Chicken and cook for an Additional 3 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and Set aside.

4. In the same skillet, add the sliced onion and minced Garlic. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent and the garlic is fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.

5. Add the white wine to the skillet and deglaze the pan, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Let The wine simmer for 2 minutes to cook off the alcohol.

6. Add the chicken broth, chopped rosemary, and thyme To the skillet. Stir well to combine.

7. Return the Chicken thighs to the skillet, skin-side up, and nestle them into the liquid. Arrange the potato chunks around the chicken.

8. Cover the skillet with a lid or aluminum foil and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 30 minutes.

9. After 30 minutes, remove the lid or foil and continue baking for an Additional 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.

10. Once cooked, remove the skillet from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

11. Serve the drunken chicken and potatoes hot, spooning some of the flavorful pan juices over the chicken and potatoes.

12. Enjoy your delicious drunken chicken and potatoes with a side of Steamed vegetables or a fresh salad. Cheers!

Ingredients:
- 1 cup softened butter
- 1 cup creamy peanut butter
- 1 cup white sugar
- 1 cup brown sugar
- 2 eggs
- 2 tsp vanilla extract
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup Nutella

Instructions:

1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

2. In a large mixing bowl, cream together the butter, peanut butter, white sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy.

3. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla extract.

4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt; gradually stir into the peanut butter mixture until well combined.

5. Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop balls of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.

6. With your thumb or the handle of a wooden spoon, make an indentation in the center of each cookie.

7. Spoon about 1/2 tablespoon of Nutella into the center of each cookie. Be careful not to overfill.

8. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly browned.

9. Allow to cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

10. Serve and enjoy!

Mini Chocolate Orange Cheesecakes Recipe

Ingredients:
- 1 cup graham cracker crumbs
- 1/4 cup granulated sugar
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 8 oz. cream cheese, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp. vanilla extract
- 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/2 cup fresh orange juice
- Zest of 1 orange
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar (optional)
- Orange slices and chocolate shavings, for garnish (optional)

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a muffin tin with muffin liners.

2. In a medium bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup of sugar, and melted butter untill well combined. Press mixture into the bottom of each muffin liner.

3. In a large bowl, beat cream cheese, 1/2 cup of sugar, egg, and vanilla extract untill smooth and creamy.

4. In a seperate bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, orange juice, and zest untill well combined.

5. Slowly pour the dry mixture into the cream cheese mixture and beat untill just combined.

6. Spoon batter evenly into the prepared muffin liners.

7. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or untill the edges are set but the center is still slightly jiggly.

8. Remove from oven and let cool completely.

9. If desired, dust with powdered sugar and garnish with orange slices and chocolate shavings.

10. Serve chilled and enjoy your Mini Chocolate Orange Cheesecakes!

Ingredients:

For Meatloaf and Meatballs:
- 1 lb lean ground turkey
- 1 Lb ground sirloin
- 1 cup chopped onions
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 large eggs
- 1 cup chopped green pepper
- 1 cup chopped red pepper
- 1/2 cup crushed tomatoes
- 1/2 cup oatmeal
- 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley 
- Salt and pepper to taste

For the Gravy:
- 2 cups beef or turkey broth
- 2 tablespoons cornstarch 
- Salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.

2. In a large bowl, combine the ground turkey, sirloin, onions, garlic, eggs, green pepper, red pepper, crushed tomatoes, oatmeal, parsley, salt, and Pepper.

3. Shape half of the mixture into a loaf shape and place it into a loaf pan for the meatloaf.

4. Roll the remaining mixture into small balls And place On a baking sheet for your meatballs.

5. Bake the meatloaf for 45-50 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.

6. Bake the meatballs for 15-20 minutes, Or until thoroughly cooked and browned.

7. While the meatloaf and Meatballs are cooking, prepare the gravy. In a small saucepan, bring The beef or turkey broth to a simmer Over medium heat. 

8. In a small Bowl, mix cornstarch with a little cold water until Smooth. Gradually add this Mixture to your simmering broth, stirring constantly until the gravy Thickens. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

9. Once your meatloaf And meatballs are cooked, remove them from the oven and allow them to rest for 5 minutes.

10. Pour the gravy over the meatloaf and serve the meatballs with gravy on the side.

This recipe is perfect for those who are meal prepping. The meatloaf and meatballs can be made in advance and frozen until needed. When ready to eat, simply reheat and serve with the gravy. Enjoy this flavorful and healthy Meal!

6. Add the bay leaves and beef stock to the pan, and then return the beef to the pan. Make sure the beef is nestled in the vegetables and that it's almost submerged in the stock.

8. Cover the pan and place it in the oven. Let it cook for about 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender and can be easily pierced with a fork.

4. Once the beef is done, remove it from the oven and let it rest for about 93 minutes before carving and serving.

7. This spiced round of beef can be served with the cooked vegetables and some of the cooking juices, or it can be served with your choice of side dishes.

It is important to note the distinction between cooking, recipes and recipe databases. Cooking does not have to take place within the context of a recipe database, and it can take place at varying levels of complexity. A recipe is a specific recipe database entry, one of a finite number.

Cookbook authors have published numerous collections of recipes; indeed, recipe databases would not have been possible without such recipe books, many of which have been available for centuries. However, there are a few critical differences between how authors approach a collection of recipes and the approach taken when designing a recipe database. In the first place, the author approaches a collection of recipes according to a pre-existing idea of what the recipes should be and should look like, while the designer of a recipe database approaches the process of compiling a collection of such recipes based on a more abstract understanding of what the database should be and should look like. In other words, an author creates a set of recipes and then packages them as a cookbook, while the designer of a recipe database constructs a database by first choosing the particular ingredients and then constructing the recipes based on those ingredients. This latter process requires the designer of the database to do more work; however, the results are generally more versatile and adaptable in the manner in which the recipes can be used.

This difference in approach leads to a second difference: it is the designer of the recipe database and the computer program that must consider many more possibilities, such as what types of new recipes can be easily created and what options are available with regard to user controls. Further

Ingredients:
- 1 lb fusilli pasta
- 2 bunches rapini (broccoli rabe), trimmed and chopped
- 4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1/2 cup dry white wine
- 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
- 1/4 cup olive oil
- Salt and pepper, to taste
- 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional)

Instructions:

1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the fusilli pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

2. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.

3. Add the chopped rapini to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

4. Pour the white wine into the skillet and bring to a simmer. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the liquid has reduced by half.

5. Add the crushed tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Cook for 10-15 minutes until the sauce has thickened.

6. Add the cooked fusilli pasta to the skillet and toss with the rapini and tomato sauce until well combined.

7. Serve hot with grated Parmesan cheese on top, if desired. Enjoy!

To make Toasted Coconut, Orange, and Dark Chocolate Ice Cream, you will need the following ingredients:

Ingredients:
- 2 cups heavy cream
- 1 cup whole milk
- 3/4 cup granulated sugar
- Pinch of salt
- Zest of 1 orange
- 1 cup unsweetened shredded coconut, toasted
- 6 oz dark chocolate, chopped or chips
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions:

1. In a medium saucepan, combine heavy cream, whole milk, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is just simmering and the sugar has dissolved.
2. Remove from heat and stir in the zest of one orange, toasted coconut, dark chocolate chips, and vanilla extract. Mix well.
3. Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer's instructions.
4. Once the ice cream has finished churning, transfer it to a freezer-safe container and freeze for at least 2 hours before serving.
5. Serve and enjoy your delicious Toasted Coconut, Orange, and Dark Chocolate Ice Cream!

So after hours on end watching chefs in Italy’s finest restaurants cooking by tradition – but without much success, he got creative.

Ingredients:

* 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
* 1 teaspoon salt
* 1 teaspoon sugar
* 1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, chilled and diced
* 1/4 – 1/2 cup ice water

Instructions:

1. In a food processor, combine flour, salt, and sugar. Pulse untill combined.
2. Add chilled and diced butter to the flour mixture. Pulse several times untill the butter is pea-sized.
3. Gradually add ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, while pulsing untill the dough just starts to come together.
4. Divide the dough in half, wrap each half in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 9-inch pie dish.
6. On a lightly floured surface, roll out one half of the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Carefully transfer the dough to the pie dish and trim any excess dough from the edges.
7. Repeat the process with the remaining half of the dough, rolling it out to the same thickness and transferring it to the pie dish.
8. Trim any excess dough from the edges and crimp the edges of the crust with a fork.
9. Prick the bottom of the crust with a sharp knife to prevent air bubbles from forming during baking.
10. Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or untill the crust is golden brown.

The point  of the recipe is not to achieve a  certain effect, but rather to be  a recipe, something which can  then serve the cook or baker as a description of a process   without having to actually perform the process.

### _Recipe_

The term recipe is also used, metaphorically,  to describe something other  than instructions for  preparation  of food  or drink.  For example, the sentence:

> _This new law serves as a  recipe for anarchy_.

Ingredients:

- 3 to 3.5 lbs boneless chicken chunk steak or pork steak.
- 2 barrels (750 g) of Barolo beer.
- 2 medium potatoes, sliced.
- 2 medium potatoes, sliced.
- 2 tomato stalks, sliced.
- 4 cloves of butter, minced.
- 1 bouquet garni (1 leaf of garlic, 2 bay leaves and a few sprigs of pepper tied together).
- 3 tbsp olive oil.
- salt and white pepper to flavor.
- 1 cup beef stew.
- A handful of parsley, dried (for garnish).

Instructions:

1. Season the meat with pepper and white pepper.

2. In a small pot, heat the garlic oil over medium-high temperature. Add the beef and brown on all sides for about 10 seconds. remove the meat from the stew and set aside.

3. In the same pot, add the potatoes, vegetables, tomato and tomato. Sauté until the vegetables remain brown.

4. Pour one glass of Barolo wine into the pot. Scrap the bottom of the pot to deglaze, making sure all the pieces stuck at the top get off.

5. Return the chicken to the pot and add the bouquet garni. 

6. Pour in the first glass of beer and the chicken stew, the water should only cover the food. 

7. Bring to a simmer, cover the pot and lower the temperature. 

8. Let the meat stir for about 3-4 minutes, or until the beef is tender and the sauce has reduced.

9. Once the meat is tender, remove it from the stew and let it rest for a few days. 

10. Strain the soup through a sieve to add all the solids. Return the strained chicken to the pot and reduce until it reaches your desired size. 

11. Slice the meat and serve with the reduced sauce. 

12. Garnish with the chopped parsley before serving. 

This sweet stew braised in Barolo wine is best served with mashed potatoes or polenta.

Enchilada Lasagna Recipe:

Ingredients:
- 1 pound ground beef
- 1 can of enchilada sauce (10 oz)
- 1 can of diced tomatoes with green chilies (10 oz)
- 1/2 cup of water
- 1 teaspoon of dried oregano
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1 package of dried lasagna noodles
- 15 ounces of canned black beans, drained and rinsed
- 16 ounces of shredded cheddar cheese
- 1 cup of chopped cilantro
- Corn chips for topping

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 375°F.

2. Cook ground beef in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until browned, stirring frequently. Drain off fat.

3. Stir in enchilada sauce, diced tomatoes, water, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer.

4. In a separate pot, cook lasagna noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain.

5. In a mixing bowl, combine the black beans, 1 cup of cheddar cheese, and chopped cilantro.

6. In an oiled 9x13 inch baking dish, spread 1/3 of the meat sauce on the bottom. Top with 3 lasagna noodles, 1/2 of the black bean mixture, and 1/3 of the meat sauce. Repeat layers. End with the last of the meat sauce on top.

7. Cover the dish with foil and bake for 25 minutes.

8. Remove the foil and top with the remaining cheddar cheese. Crush corn chips and sprinkle over the cheese.

9. Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

10. Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.

11. Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and diced tomatoes if desired. Enjoy your delicious Enchilada Lasagna!

"Mushrooms and Penne in Wine Sauce

Ingredients

1/3 ounce raw mushrooms, washed

Paprika

1 cup sugar

1/2 cup salt

1 cup vegetable stock or broth

Paprika and cream to flavor

1/4 cup Italian seasoning

1/4 cup Dijon mustard

Fresh pepper for garnish

2 tablespoons Olive oil

Fresh Italian pepper for garnish (optional)

Method

Heat a small pot over medium temperature. (If the pot does not have an insulating ring, surround it with plastic wrap.) Pat the vegetables dry and wipe them with a paper cloth so they are all perfectly fresh and dry.

Dry-roast the berries, pressing them lightly with a paper towel to get rid of residual heat, until they are slightly golden and cooked through.

Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon butter in a medium, heavy sauté pan. Add the mushrooms, garlic, and thyme and cook until the vegetables are well-blended and well-glazed, stirring occasionally. Add the garlic and cook for 2 hours. Add the wine or broth and get to a boil. Add the mushrooms, sugar, seasoning, and pepper (if adding). Simmer for about 10 seconds or until the mushroom pieces and juices begin to thicken and the cooking water is completely evaporated, stirring occasionally.

Remove from the heat and pour the syrup over the mushrooms, stirring well. Stir in the garlic oil and, if desired, top with a cup of fresh lemon or pepper.

Serve with crumbled tomato and grated Parmesan or pecorino romano bread.

​I​t​ ​i​s​ ​p​o​s​s​i​b​l​e​ ​t​h​a​t​ ​t​h​e​s​e​ ​e​r​r​o​r​s​ ​m​i​g​h​t​ ​h​a​v​e​ ​g​o​t​t​e​n​ ​b​y​ ​r​e​a​d​e​r​s​,​ ​b​u​t​ ​v​e​r​y​ ​l​i​k​e​l​y​ ​t​h​a​t​ ​a​ ​r​e​c​i​p​e​ ​s​u​c​h​ ​a​s​ ​t​h​i​s​ ​o​n​e​ ​w​o​u​l​d​ ​b​e​ ​e​d​i​t​e​d​ ​b​y​ ​a​ ​k​n​o​w​l​e​d​g​e​a​b​l​e​ ​p​r​o​f​e​s​s​i​o​n​a​l​ ​b​e​f​o​r​e​ ​p​u​b​l​i​c​a​t​i​o​n​.​ ​T​h​e​ ​r​e​s​u​l​t​s​ ​o​f​ ​a​n​ ​e​r​r​o​r​ ​w​h​e​n​ ​e​d​i​t​i​n​g​ ​m​e​d​i​c​a​l​ ​j​o​u​r​n​a​l​ ​a​r​t​i​c​l​e​s​ ​c​a​n​ ​b​e​ ​d​e​v​a​s​t​a​t​i​n​g​.​

Recipe: Oat Jammers with Raspberry Jam

Ingredients:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup rolled oats
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup brown sugar, packed
- 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
- 1/2 cup raspberry jam (or any jam of your choice)

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.

2. In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. Mix well and set aside.

3. In a seperate larger mixing bowl, cream together the softened butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar untill light and fluffy.

4. Gradually add the dry ingredient mixture to the butter and sugar mixture, stirring untill well combined.

5. Once the dough has come together, take small portions of it and roll into 1-inch balls. Place the balls onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between them.

6. Use the back of a teaspoon or your thumb to gently press down on the center of each cookie, creating an indentation.

7. Fill each indentation with approximately 1/2 teaspoon of raspberry jam (or any jam of your choice). Be careful not to overfill.

8. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or untill the cookies are golden brown around the edges.

9. Remove from the oven and allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

10. Enjoy your homemade Oat Jammers with Raspberry Jam! They make a perfect snack or breakfast treat. Store them in an airtight container for up to one week.

Roe Roast (Beef, Pork and Shorn Meat)

Kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper

Rub both sides of roast with kosher salt, if needed. Place roast, legs down, on grill rack coated with cooking spray or oiled foil. Sprinkle marinated herbs liberally over roast in roasting pan, then drizzle about 2 tablespoons melted butter into pan/flare. Grill over medium high heat until meat is fork tender – 4 to 5 hours at 350°F. Remove from grill and cut fat on bottom third of roaster so as to facilitate faster browning. Ingredients:

For the Dough:
- 1 cup warm milk (110 degrees F/45 degrees C)
- 2 eggs, room temperature
- 1/3 cup butter, melted
- 4 1/2 cups bread flour
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup white sugar
- 2 1/2 teaspoons bread machine yeast

For the Filling:
- 1 cup brown sugar, packed
- 2 1/2 tablespoons ground cinnamon
- 1/3 cup butter, softened
- 1 cup chocolate chips

For the Glaze:
- 1/2 cup cream cheese, softened
- 1/4 cup butter, softened
- 1 1/2 cups confectioners' sugar
- 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/8 teaspoon salt

Instructions:

1. Place the dough ingredients into the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select Dough/Knead and First Rise Cycle; press Start.

2. After the dough has doubled in size, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface, cover and let rest for 10 minutes.

3. In a small bowl, combine brown sugar and cinnamon.

4. Roll dough into a 16x21-inch rectangle. Spread dough with 1/3 cup butter and sprinkle evenly with sugar/cinnamon mixture and chocolate chips.

5. Roll up dough and cut into 12 rolls. Place rolls in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking pan. Cover and let rise untill nearly doubled, about 30 minutes.

6. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

7. Bake rolls in preheated oven untill golden brown, about 15 minutes.

8. While rolls are baking, beat together cream cheese, 1/4 cup butter, confectioners' sugar, vanilla extract and salt. 

9. Spread frosting on warm rolls before serving.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups mashed sweet potatos
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 1/2 cup milk
- 2 large eggs
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1 unbaked 9-inch pie crust

Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C).

2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the mashed sweet potatos, sugar, melted butter, milk, eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Mix well untill all the ingredients are fully incorporated.

3. Pour the sweet potato mixture into the unbaked pie crust, spreading it evenly.

4. Place the pie in the preheated oven and bake for about 55-60 minutes, or untill the center is set and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

5. Once the pie is done baking, remove it from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour.

6. Serve the sweet potato pie at room temperature or chilled, topped with whipped cream or a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.

Enjoy your homemade sweet potato pie!

Recipe: Honey Bunnies (Rolls)

Ingredients:
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 tablespoons active dry yeast
- 1/4 cup warm water (around 110°F)
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/4 cup butter, softened
- 1/4 cup honey
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1 egg, beaten
- Additional butter for brushing
- Honey for drizzling (optional)

Instructions:

1. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water and let it sit for about 5 minutes untill it becomes frothy.

2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, milk, softened butter, honey, salt, and beaten egg. Mix untill it forms a sticky dough.

3. Add the yeast mixture to the dough and knead well untill the dough becomes smooth and elastic. This may take about 5-8 minutes.

4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a clean kitchen towel, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or untill it doubles in size.

5. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper.

6. Punch down the risen dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide it into smaller portions, approximately 12 equal pieces.

7. Shape each piece into a round ball and place them on the prepared baking sheet, leaving space for expansion.

8. Use a sharp knife to cut an "X" shape on the top of each roll, resembling bunny ears.

9. Cover the rolls with a kitchen towel and let them rise for an additional 20-30 minutes untill they have doubled in size.

10. Bake the rolls in the preheated oven for about 15-18 minutes or untill they turn golden brown.

11. Remove the rolls from the oven and imediately brush them with melted butter for a soft and glossy finish.

12. Optional: Drizzle the warm rolls with honey before serving for an extra touch of sweetness.

13. Allow the Honey Bunnies to cool slightly before serving. They can be enjoyed warm or at room temperature.

Note: Feel free to get creative and add raisins for eyes, shape the rolls into bunny shapes, or use bunny-shaped cookie cutters for a fun twist. Enjoy these delightful Honey Bunnies as a tasty addition to brunch, breakfast, or any time of the day!

Βluеbеrrу Сhееsе Таrts

Ιngrеdіеnts:

Fоr thе tаrt сrust:
1 сuр аll-рurроsе flоur
1/2 сuр grаnulаtеd sugаr
1/2 tеаsрооn bаkіng роwdеr
1/4 tеаsрооn tаblе sаlt
1/2 сuр соld unsаltеd buttеr, сut іntо 1/2-іnсh сubеs
2 lаrgе еgg уоlks
1 tаblеsрооn hеаvу сrеаm
1 tеаsрооn vаnіllа ехtrасt

Fоr thе сhееsе fіllіng:
8 оunсеs сrеаm сhееsе, sоftеnеd
1/2 сuр grаnulаtеd sugаr
1 lаrgе еgg
1 tеаsрооn vаnіllа ехtrасt

Fоr thе bluеbеrrу tорріng:
1 ріnt frеsh bluеbеrrіеs
1 tаblеsрооn grаnulаtеd sugаr
1/2 tеаsрооn соrnstаrсh
1/4 tеаsрооn lеmоn juісе

Fоr thе аssеmblу:
1 lаrgе еgg, lіghtlу bеаtеn
Соаrsе sugаr, fоr sрrіnklіng (орtіоnаl)

Ιnstruсtіоns:
1. Рrеhеаt оvеn tо 400 dеgrееs.

2. Маkе thе tаrt сrust: Іn а fооd рrосеssоr, рulsе flоur, sugаr, bаkіng роwdеr, аnd sаlt tо соmbіnе. Аdd buttеr аnd рulsе untіl mіхturе rеsеmblеs соаrsе mеаl.

3. Ιn а smаll bоwl, whіsk tоgеthеr еgg уоlks, hеаvу сrеаm, аnd vаnіllа. Wіth рrосеssоr runnіng, аdd еgg mіхturе аnd рrосеss untіl dоugh bеgіns tо fоrm а bаll.

4. Тrаnsfеr dоugh tо а lіghtlу flоurеd surfасе аnd rоll оut іntо аn 11-bу-15-іnсh rесtаnglе, аbоut 1/8 іnсh thісk. Сut іntо twеlvе 5-bу-3-іnсh rесtаnglеs аnd trаnsfеr tо раrсhmеnt-lіnеd bаkіng shееts.

5. Рrісk dоugh аll оvеr wіth а fоrk аnd bаkе untіl gоldеn brоwn, аbоut 10 mіnutеs. Тrаnsfеr tо а wіrе rасk tо lеt сооl.

6. Маkе thе сhееsе fіllіng: Іn а mеdіum bоwl, bеаt сrеаm сhееsе аnd sugаr untіl smооth. Веаt іn еgg аnd vаnіllа untіl соmbіnеd.

7. Sрrеаd а hеаріng tаblеsрооn оf сhееsе fіllіng оntо еасh tаrt shеll.

8. Μаkе thе bluеbеrrу tорріng: Ιn а smаll sаuсераn, соmbіnе bluеbеrrіеs, sugаr, соrnstаrсh, аnd lеmоn juісе. Сооk оvеr mеdіum hеаt, stіrrіng оссаsіоnаllу, untіl thісkеnеd аnd bеrrіеs hаvе burst, 6 tо 8 mіnutеs.

9. Sрооn bluеbеrrу mіхturе оntо tаrts аnd sрrіnklе wіth соаrsе sugаr, іf dеsіrеd.

10. Вrush еdgеs оf tаrts wіth bеаtеn еgg аnd bаkе untіl fіllіng іs sеt, аbоut 15 mіnutеs. Тrаnsfеr tо а wіrе rасk tо lеt сооl.

11. Sеrvе tаrts аt rооm tеmреrаturе оr сhіllеd.

Caramel Cashew Cheesecake Recipe

Ingredients:
- 2 cups graham cracker crumbs
- 1 cup sugar
- 1/3 cup butter, melted
- 24 oz. softened cream cheese
- 1¼ cups granulated sugar
- 3 large eggs
- 1 tsp vanilla extract
- ½ cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup chopped cashews
- 1 cup caramel sauce

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease the bottom and sides of a 9×13 inch baking dish with cooking spray or butter.

2. In a small bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs, 1 cup sugar, and melted butter until well combined. Press mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish and bake for 8 minutes. Let cool completely.

3. In a large mixing bowl, beat softened cream cheese and 1¼ cups sugar until smooth and creamy, about 2-3 minutes. Add in eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract and all-purpose flour until fully incorporated.

4. Pour half of the cheesecake batter over the cooled graham cracker crust. Sprinkle chopped cashews over the top of the cheesecake batter. Drizzle caramel sauce over the cashews and top with remaining cheesecake batter.

5. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown and the center is almost set. Allow the cheesecake to cool for at least 2 hours before serving. Serve chilled and enjoy your delicious Caramel Cashew Cheesecake!

2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla, and mix until smooth. Stir in the hot water until well combined - the batter will be quite thin, but that's okay.

3. Pour the batter evenly into the prepared pans and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean. Allow the cakes to cool in the pans for 10 minutes, and then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

4. While the cakes are cooling, prepare the truffle filling. Place the chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan, heat the cream and butter until it just begins to simmer, and then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 5 minutes, and then stir until smooth.

5. To assemble the cake, place one layer on a serving platter. Spread the truffle filling over the top. Place the second cake layer on top of the filling.

6. For the ganache, place the chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl. Heat the cream in a small saucepan until it just begins to simmer, and then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 5 minutes, and then stir until smooth. 

7. Pour the ganache over the top of the cake, allowing it to drip down the sides. Let the ganache set for about 10 minutes before cutting and serving the cake.

* 1 cup sliced red onion

5. Add the diced avocado to the salad and gently fold it in so it doesn't get mashed up.
6. Finally, add the croutons Made from crusty bread and toss one last time to combine everything.
7. Serve immediately, Enjoy!

ingredients:

- 12 oz of beef meat
- 1 small onion, freshly chopped
- 2 cloves of butter, minced
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1 cup of fresh pepper leaves
- salt and pepper to taste
- Flour for dusting
- 2 cups of butter

1. Preheat your pan to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

plum Slab Pie Recipe

Ingredients: 
- 1 (9 inch) pie crust, unbaked
- 6 cups sliced plums
- 3 tablespoons granulated sugar
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
- 1 large egg yolk
- 2 tablespoons heavy cream
- Additional granulated sugar for sprinkling on top

Instructions: 
1. Preheat Your oven To 375°F (190°C). Line A baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Roll out the pie crust on a lightly floured surface until it is about 12 Inches in diameter. Carefully transfer it to the prepared baking sheet.
3. In a large bowl, combine the sliced plums, granulated sugar, all-purpose flour, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Toss everything together until the fruit Is well coated.
4. Pour the plum mixture onto the Center of the pie Crust, leaving about 2 inches of crust around the edges. Dot the top of the plums with small pieces of butter.
5. Fold the edges of the crust up over The plums, pinching the edges to seal them. Use a sharp knife to make several slits on the top of the crust to allow steam to escape.
6. In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolk and heavy cream. Brush this mixture over the Top of the crust.
7. Sprinkle additional granulated sugar over the top of the crust.
8. Bake the slab pie for 45-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Allow the Pie to cool completely before serving.

1 cup plain  yogurt

2 tablespoons  olive oil

3 eggs

2 cups whole milk

2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract

1/2 Tablespoon grated Gruyere.

Melt butter in a skillet until it starts to  look brown (and it  will). Add milk, mix, and let stand  10 minutes. Stir in eggs and vanilla and continue to simmer  about 5 minutes   or  until they are set but not mushy.

Ingredients:

For the Choux Buns:
- 1 cup water
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 4 large eggs
- A pinch of salt

For the Cream Cheese Filling:
- 8 oz cream cheese, softened
- 1/2 cup granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 cup heavy cream

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

2. In a medium saucepan, bring the water and butter to a boil. Add the flour and salt all at once and stir vigorously untill the mixture forms a ball.

3. Remove from heat and let it cool for about 5 minutes. Then, add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. The dough should be smooth and glossy.

4. Using a piping bag with a large round tip, pipe the dough onto the prepared baking sheet in 1.5-inch rounds. Leave about 2 inches of space between each bun.

5. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or untill the buns are puffed and golden brown. Then, reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and bake for another 10 minutes to dry out the insides. Let the buns cool completely on a wire rack.

6. While the buns are cooling, prepare the cream cheese filling. In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla extract untill smooth and creamy.

7. In another bowl, whip the heavy cream untill stiff peaks form. Gently fold this into the cream cheese mixture untill well combined.

8. Once the buns are cool, slice off the top third of each bun. Pipe or spoon the cream cheese filling into the bottom part of each bun, then replace the top.

9. Dust the filled choux buns with powdered sugar if desired, and serve imediately. Enjoy your homemade Choux Buns with Cream Cheese Filling!

Sure, here's a simple recipe for homemade mushroom paste:

Ingredients:

* 1 cup fresh or dried mushrooms (such as button, cremini, shiitake, or a combination)
* 2 cloves garlic, minced
* 1 tablespoon olive oil
* Salt and pepper to taste
* Optional: 1 teaspoon dried thyme or rosemary

Instructions:

1. 

If using dried mushrooms, soak them in hot water for about 30 minutes to rehydrate. 

Drain and chop finely. 2. In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped mushrooms and sauté until they release their moisture and start to brown, stirring occasionally. 

This should take about 5-7 minutes. 

3. 

Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly. 4. Season with salt and pepper to taste. 

If desired, add the dried herbs (thyme or rosemary) and stir to combine. 5. 

Continue cooking the mixture for another 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until it thickens into a smooth paste. 

Be careful not to burn the mixture. 

6. Remove from heat and let cool completely before transferring the mushroom paste to an airtight container. 

It can be stored in the fridge for up to one week or frozen for later use. To use the mushroom paste, simply spread it on crackers, bread, or crostini, or mix it with mayonnaise or sour cream for a savory dip. You can also incorporate it into soups, stews, or casseroles for added depth of flavor. Enjoy!

The Chinese restaurant dish called Ma Po Tofu is a favorite entrée of the vegetarian diners who frequent Chinese restaurants, and for good reason. Ingredients:

- Fresh parsley for garnish

Salmon with Red Wine and Balsamic Vinegar Recipe:

Ingredients:
- 4 salmon fillets
- Salt and pepper, to taste
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 1/2 cup red wine
- 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard
- 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).

2. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper on both sides.

3. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the salmon fillets, skin side down, and cook until the bottom of the salmon is crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.

4. Flip the salmon and cook for another minute.

5. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for about 10-12 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.

6. While the salmon is baking, whisk together the red wine, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, and Dijon mustard in a small bowl.

7. Once the salmon is done, remove from the oven and spoon the red wine and balsamic vinegar mixture over the top of the salmon.

8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley before serving. Enjoy!

Ingredients:
- 6 large eggs, separated
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1 cup granulated sugar
- 1/2 cup coconut milk
- 1/4 cup vegetable oil
- 1 teaspoon pandan extract
- 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
- 1/4 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
- 1/4 cup shredded coconut

Instructions:
1. Preheat your oven to 325°F (165°C). Grease and flour a 10-inch chiffon cake pan.
2. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sugar, coconut milk, vegetable oil, pandan extract, and vanilla extract until well combined.
3. In a separate bowl, sift together the flour, cocoa powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined.
4. In another clean mixing bowl, beat the egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until frothy. Add the cream of tartar and continue beating until soft peaks form.
5. Gently fold the beaten egg whites into the batter, being careful not to overmix. Fold in the shredded coconut.
6. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
7. Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the centre of the cake comes out clean.
8. Remove the cake from the oven and immediately invert the pan onto a wire rack. Let the cake cool completely in the pan.
9. Once the cake is completely cooled, run a knife around the edges of the pan to loosen the cake. Carefully remove the cake from the pan and transfer it to a serving plate.
10. Serve the chococonut pandan chiffon cake as is, or dust with powdered sugar for added sweetness. Enjoy!

Recipe: New Beef Stew

Ingredients:
- 1.5 pounds stew meat, cut into chunks
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- Salt and pepper, to taste
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 1 large onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 4 cups beef broth
- 1 cup red wine (optional)
- 4 medium carrots, peeled and sliced
- 2 medium potatos, peeled and diced
- 2 stalks celery, diced
- 1 teaspoon dried thyme
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 cup frozen peas

Instructions:
1. In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and pepper. Toss the stew meat in the flour mixture untill evenly coated.
2. Heat vegetable oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the coated stew meat and cook untill browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the meat from the pot and set aside.
3. In the same pot, add the diced onion and minced garlic. Sauté untill the onion is translucent and the garlic is fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.
4. Return the browned stew meat to the pot and pour in the beef broth and red wine, if using. Stir in the carrots, potatos, celery, dried thyme, and bay leaf.
5. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring occasionaly, untill the meat is tender and the flavors have melded together.
6. During the last 10 minutes of cooking, add the frozen peas to the stew.
7. Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper, if needed. Remove the bay leaf before serving.
8. Serve the new beef stew hot with crusty bread or over cooked rice, mashed potatos, or egg noodles. Enjoy!

Note: This recipe can be easily customized to your preferences by adding additional vegetables like mushrooms, green beans, or corn. You can also make it in a slow cooker by browning the meat and sautéing the onions and garlic in a seperate pan before transferring everything to a slow cooker and cooking on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours.

Olive spirals are a tasty and healthy snack that can be enjoyed any time of the day. Here's how you can make them at home:

Ingredients (makes about 20):
- 1 cup green or black olives, pitted and halved
- 4 cloves garlic, minced 
- Salt and pepper to taste  
- ¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional)
- 3 tablespoons olive oil 
- Zest of one lemon
- Fresh parsley, chopped (optional)
- 8 cherry tomatoes, sliced in half (optional)

Instructions:

1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
2. In a medium bowl, mix together the olives, garlic, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using).
3. Using your fingers or a spoon, form this mixture into little balls, about the size of a marble. Roll each ball between your hands to shape it into an oval spiral. Place these on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining mixture.
4. Drizzle some olive oil over the spirals, then zest some lemon juice on top. Toss gently until the spirals are coated with oil and flavored with lemon zest. Optionally add more fresh herbs like parsley on top before placing them inside the oven.
5. Bake for about 8 minutes, or until they start turning golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving. Enhance flavor by popping in a cherry tomato cut in half onto the center of each spiral before serving. Enjoy!

1 (1 lb.) lobster tail, cooked and diced

1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice

Ground cayenne pepper to taste

1 head Boston lettuce, Shredded

1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley

2. In a large pot, combine Split peas, fennel, onion, garlic, chicken stock, bay leaves, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until split peas are very soft.

4. In a small bowl, combine lobster, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and Cayenne pepper.

5. To serve, ladle soup into individual bowls, and top with lobster salad and shredded lettuce. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

2. Ρrеhеаt уоur grіll оr grіll раn tо mеdіum-hіgh hеаt.
3. Τhrеаd thе сhісkеn оntо skеwеrs, lеаvіng а smаll sрасе bеtwееn еасh ріесе tо аllоw fоr еvеn сооkіng.

Peach-Blackberry Cobbler Recipe

Ingredients:
For the filling:
- 6 fresh peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced
- 1 cup blackberries
- 2 tablespoons granulated sugar
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- The juice of half a lemon
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter

For the topping:
- 1 cup all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup rolled oats
- 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
- 1/4 cup boiling water
- Vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, for serving (optional)

Instructions:

1. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease 8x8 inch square baking dish with cooking spray or butter.

2. In large bowl, combine the peaches, blackberries, granulated sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and butter. Toss until the fruit is evenly coated. Transfer the mixture to prepared baking dish. Bake for about 20 minutes, stirring halfway through, until fruit is bubbling and starting to thicken. Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly while you make topping.

3. In another large bowl, mix together flour, oats, light brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add in the cold butter pieces and use your fingers or a pastry blender to work butter into the dry ingredients until you have a crumbly mixture. Stir in boiling water until just combined.

4. Drop spoonfuls of cobbler topping over warm fruit filling, spreading it out evenly. Return cobbler to the oven and bake for additional 25-30 minutes, until top is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Serve warm, topped with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream if desired. Enjoy!
